    Description
    final class 
    BrowserUrlNormalizer
    The dedup-identity normalizer for browser-discovered URLs: lowercases scheme/host, drops the fragment, drops the default port, resolves ./.. segments, maps an empty path to /, and applies the configured QueryParameterPolicy.

  • Uses of IUrlNormalizer in io.webagent4j.crawler

    Classes in io.webagent4j.crawler that implement IUrlNormalizer
    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    final class 
    DefaultUrlNormalizer
    Deterministic IUrlNormalizer: lowercases scheme and host, drops the fragment, drops a default port (:80 for http, :443 for https), resolves ./ .. path segments (URI.normalize()), maps an empty path to "/", and applies a fixed QueryParameterPolicy - never reordering surviving query parameters or re-encoding anything, so already-valid percent-encoding is never corrupted.
